title: A Polynomial-Time Test for Peak-Oriented Rationalizability
abstract: arXiv:2609.30042v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the computational complexity of peak-oriented rationalizability, a survey based revealed-preference test introduced by Seror (2026). We provide a polynomial-time algorithm for testing rationalizability and recovering a utility function, establishing that peak-oriented preference elicitation is computationally tractable. In contrast, we show that computing the peak-oriented Houtman-Maks index is NP-hard. These results delineate the precise computational boundaries of peak-oriented revealed-preference analysis.

translated_title: 峰值导向理性化的多项式时间检验
translated_abstract: 我们研究了峰值导向理性化的计算复杂度，这是由Seror (2026)提出的一种基于问卷的显示偏好检验方法。我们提供了一个多项式时间算法用于检验理性化并恢复效用函数，从而证明峰值导向的偏好引出在计算上是可行的。与之相反，我们证明了计算峰值导向的Houtman-Maks指数是NP难的。这些结果精确地刻画了峰值导向显示偏好分析的计算边界。
tldr: 本文提出了检验峰值导向理性化并恢复效用函数的多项式时间算法，证明该偏好引出方法在计算上可行，但同时证明计算峰值导向Houtman-Maks指数是NP难的。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a polynomial-time algorithm for testing peak-oriented rationalizability and recovering a utility function, establishing that peak-oriented preference elicitation is computationally tractable, while showing that computing the peak-oriented Houtman-Maks index is NP-hard.
